rule.title: The owner's own retirement contributions are not a Schedule C expense

when_missing.because: Taken as no unless a preparer says so: Is this item a retirement plan contribution made on the owner's own behalf as a self-employed person, rather than for employees?

citation.wording: If the plan included you as a self-employed person, enter the contributions made as an employer on your behalf on Schedule 1 (Form 1040), line 16, not on Schedule C.

rule.open_point: The figure is counted 0.00 on Schedule C and not moved: Schedule 1 line 16 (self-employed SEP, SIMPLE and qualified plans) is worked by the preparer's software.
